data.name: Incident Reports: Millers Residence
data.detailed_description:
A late-night call. An open door. A residence that should have stayed silent.

Incident Reports: Millers Residence is a short first-person psychological horror game about investigation, unease, and the disturbing truth hidden inside an old residence.

You play as a 1980s police investigator dispatched to an isolated home after a brief emergency call. What begins as a routine response quickly turns into something far more unsettling. The house is quiet, but every room tells a story.

Search the residence, examine objects, read documents, and piece together the events that led to the night’s horror. A dinner left unfinished. Files stacked in the dark. Personal belongings placed with intent. Strange symbols, handwritten notes, and blood-stained details point toward something someone tried to hide.

There are no easy answers waiting for you here. Only fragments, evidence, and the growing feeling that something inside the house is watching.

Features

  • First-person psychological horror

  • Investigation-focused exploration

  • Environmental storytelling through objects, notes, and visual details

  • A tense, atmospheric residence filled with disturbing clues

  • Short, linear horror experience built around mood and mystery

data.short_description: A late-night call sends you to the Millers Residence. What begins as a routine investigation turns into a descent through buried records, missing evidence, and a house arranged to hide something far worse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains psychological horror, jump scares, disturbing crime scene imagery, blood markings/drawings, ritual-like symbols, murder-related themes, and depictions of corpses including a hanging body. There is no sexual content.
